name: codebase-kg
description: Builds, maintains, and serves a per-repo code graph — a committed SQLite map of any codebase (nodes = components, symbol anchors = where they live, edges = relationships) so an agent can orient and find code without re-deriving the map every session. Constant-time load and indexed full-text search at any size; dangling edges and inconsistent data are impossible to write, not merely reported. Language-agnostic. Cross-codebase parity linking tracks feature gaps between paired repos (e.g. an iOS app and its Android port). A search gate points the agent at the graph before it greps; the commit check advises, and the push check blocks only on a stale-graph backlog.
